description: Price a custom patch from the live PatchDesign.AI production price table: type, size and quantity in, the per-patch and total price in USD out, with the next quantity breaks and what the price already includes (artwork, a pre-production sample, worldwide shipping). There is no minimum: quantity 1 returns the sample prices, and by default quote the price breaks. Use it when the user asks about a price or a minimum.

patchType.description: Patch type: embroidered (default), woven, chenille, printed, pvc-2d or pvc-3d. Iron-on, velcro and sew-on are backings on an embroidered patch, so use embroidered for those.

quantity.description: How many patches. Default 100. Use 1 for a single patch.

name: quote_patch
title: Price a custom patch
